### Short Answer

### Controlling Authorities
The relevant provision is Section 27 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which outlines the rates of income tax on domestic corporations. Specifically, it states that domestic corporations are generally taxed at a rate of 25% on their taxable income derived from all sources within and without the Philippines.
